title: viola pachysoma
intro: Viola pachysoma, commonly known as Mountain Panke or Purple Panke, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the violet family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Viola pachysoma are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to clear mucus from the lungs and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
